fusions.name: Final Clause
fusions.desc: Fires an inscribed round at a target at or below 25% health, dealing 24 damage.

fusions.name: Recited Volley
fusions.desc: Fires 3 inscribed rounds in a spread, each dealing 5 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warding Script
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Practiced Litany
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
